components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: High-contrast warm white pill CTA for primary research and contact actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.97 0.005 80); color: oklch(0.16 0.01 260); font-family: 'Wix Madefor Text', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.90 0.008 80); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.70 0.14 275); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Hero Quiet Ghost Pill
components.description: 5% translucent ghost pill with warm-white rim for secondary actions over photography.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.05); color: oklch(0.97 0.005 80); font-family: 'Wix Madefor Text', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.24); transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.12); border-color: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.36); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.70 0.14 275); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Smoked Glass Ledger Row
components.description: Interactive smoked glass ledger row with monogram badge, periwinkle status check, and tabular metric.
components.css: .ds-glass { background: oklch(0.14 0.015 260 / 0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.4); border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.10); border-radius: 16px; padding: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.97 0.005 80); font-family: 'Wix Madefor Text', sans-serif; } .ds-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.25rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.09); border: none; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.14); } .ds-init { width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.08); border: 1px solid oklch(0.98 0.005 80 / 0.10); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-name { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-meta { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: oklch(0.76 0.01 255); } .ds-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

narrative.northStar: The Smoked Glass Workbench at Dusk
narrative.overview:
This design system sets rigorous machine learning research (MLE-Dojo, NeurIPS 2025) and low-footprint native desktop engineering (FileBot Nova) against a quiet, atmospheric landscape at sunset. Rather than shouting with neon syntax gradients, floating orbs, or decorative skill progress bars, the page behaves like an interactive instrument panel suspended over a valley of fog under a warm apricot-and-slate sky.

Below the hero fold, the sky darkens into deep slate-indigo (--color-paper) where two distinct surface treatments do the work: smoked glass panes (backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.4) with a 10% warm-white rim) for live interactive inspection, and warm bone wells (oklch(0.95 0.008 75)) that hold academic citations and desktop screenshots like lit pages on a dark desk.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric Dusk Stage: Full-bleed twilight landscape under a directional dark scrim, pairing two-line display typography on the left with a smoked glass research-and-systems ledger on the right.
Dual-Surface Polarity: Smoked glass panes for interactive state inspection; warm bone wells for published artifacts.
Restrained Signal Accents: Periwinkle and sunset apricot appear strictly as 7px status dots, active row markers, and focus rings—never as flood fills or gradient washes.
Ruled Editorial Precision: Experience history and technical stack are set as clean, hairline-divided multi-column rows with tabular-nums alignment.

rules.name: The Signal-Dot Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle (--color-accent) and Apricot (--color-warm) never fill buttons, cards, or section backgrounds. They appear only on indicator dots (7px), 16px status icons, and 2px focus rings.

rules.name: The Dual-Polarity Rule
rules.body: Whenever a surface switches to --color-well (Warm Bone), all child typography and hairlines must switch to --color-well-ink, --color-well-quiet, and --color-well-hair so contrast exceeds 11:1.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, button, badge, and table header is set in sentence case. All-caps tracked labels (text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em) are forbidden.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Metrics, counts (200+ tasks, 153 KB, 1,500 students), and date ranges use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Single-Boundary Rule
rules.body: A container defines its edge with a 1px hairline border (--color-hair or --color-well-hair) OR tonal contrast—never both a hairline border and a wide box-shadow.

dos: Do keep the hero h1 at 6 words or fewer so it sets cleanly in 2 lines beside the smoked glass ledger.
Do use 1px solid var(--color-hair) (or --color-well-hair inside bone wells) to divide rows and metadata lists without introducing nested cards.
Do verify every interactive element has explicit :hover, :focus-visible, :active, and :disabled states and honors @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
Do credit every Commons/library photograph in the footer [data-credits] line (Thomas Bresson, CC BY 3.0, Wikimedia Commons).
donts: Don't place a bordered, rounded card inside another bordered, rounded .glass or .bone-well container (nested-cards).
Don't use uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows above h1 or h2 headings.
Don't hide table columns on mobile (< 40rem); restack .pane-table rows vertically so mobile visitors read the full technical content.
Don't use purple-to-blue/pink gradients, glowing orbs, or transition: all.
